page.heading: Start a return
page.loadError: We cannot show your return options now. Try again later.
page.notReturnable: You cannot return items from this order.

select.heading: Select items
select.help: Select the items that you want to send back.
select.exchangeOrder: This order is an exchange. You cannot exchange it again. You can request a refund or store credit. Both have the return shipping and handling fee.

locked.final_sale: Final sale. You cannot return this item.
locked.not_delivered: This item is not delivered yet.

exchange.freeLabelNote: We send you a free return label when your new order is of equal or greater value than the returned item.
exchange.stepSubmit: Select the button below and we will review your request.
exchange.step1: Place a new order in our store for the item that you want. The new order must be of equal or greater value. You pay for the new item and its shipping.
exchange.step2: At checkout, make sure the order note says “Exchange {{order}}”. The Shop latest button adds it for you. If it is not there, type it.
exchange.step3: When we see your new order, we send you a free return label by email. Write your order number, {{name}}, on the packing list.
exchange.step4: Send the return {{returnWindow}}. We refund the returned item after we receive it.

done.heading: We received your request
done.body: We received your return request for order {{name}}.
done.exchangeBody: We received your exchange request for order {{name}}.

choose.heading: Return or exchange
choose.error: We cannot send your request. Try again or contact us.

confirm.returnHeading: Return for store credit or a refund

policy.heading: Return policy
policy.condition: Items must be new and unused, with all tags attached. Do not wear, change, or wash the items.
policy.timing: We process your return 1 to 2 business days after we receive it. Your bank can need 3 to 5 more business days.
policy.agree: I read the return policy. My items are new and unused, with all tags attached.
policy.agreeRequired: Confirm that you read the return policy.

return.stepSubmit: Select the button below and we will review your request.
return.step1: We send you a return label by email.
return.step2: Pack the items neatly. Put a copy of the packing list in the box, and write your order number, {{name}}, on it. Remove old labels from the box.
return.step3: Print the label at actual size and attach it to the box. Give the box to the carrier on the label. Ship the return {{returnWindow}}.
return.step4: When we receive the return, we send your refund or store credit, minus the fees in your estimate. We send you an email within 1 to 2 days.

international.step1: Pack the items neatly. Put a copy of the packing list in the box, and write your order number, {{name}}, on it.
international.step2: Write “Returned Goods” on the box and on the customs form.
international.step3: Send the box, tracked and insured, to: [Your return address]. You pay for return shipping. Send it {{returnWindow}}.
international.step4: When we receive the return, we send your refund or store credit, minus the fees in your estimate. We send you an email within 1 to 2 days.
